queries.label: latest session for agreement
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM ambient_sessions WHERE agreement_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

queries.label: session by provider capture id
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM ambient_sessions WHERE paypal_capture_id = ? LIMIT 1

queries.label: payment operation by provider ref
queries.sql: SELECT session_id FROM ambient_payment_operations WHERE provider_ref = ? LIMIT 1

notes: This measures prepared SQLite statements on a disposable copy of the local seeded database.
It does not measure HTTP, browser audio processing, concurrent clients, or production scale.
